Messages.Help: Commands: /{cmd} status, center, center here, center here snap, on, off, reset, show. Center look uses the building block you aim at. Center here uses your feet and horizontal look. Snap locks that yaw to 90 degrees. Symmetry mirrors across the two vertical planes and both together. It does not spin four rotated copies.
Messages.StatusOn: Symmetry is on. Center {source} at {pos}, yaw {yaw}.
Messages.StatusOff: Symmetry is off. Center {source} at {pos}, yaw {yaw}.
Messages.StatusNoCenter: Symmetry is off. No center set. Aim at a block and use /{cmd} center, or /{cmd} center here.
Messages.CenterLook: Center set on the {prefab} pivot at {pos}, yaw {yaw}. Planes are vertical through that yaw.
Messages.CenterHere: Center set at your feet {pos}, yaw {yaw}.
Messages.CenterFailed: Look at a building block within {dist}m, or use /{cmd} center here.
Messages.CenterLevel: Look horizontally enough to define a forward axis.
Messages.Enabled: Symmetry on. The next building-plan pieces mirror to the other sides when those spots pass normal build checks.
Messages.NeedCenter: Set a center before turning symmetry on.
Messages.Disabled: Symmetry off. The center is unchanged.
Messages.Reset: Symmetry center cleared and symmetry turned off.
Messages.Show: Showing the center and both axes for {seconds}s. Side axis is accent, depth axis is muted.
Messages.OnAxis: No extra copy. That piece already lies on the mirror.
Messages.Unsupported: {prefab} is not in the symmetry allow list.
Messages.Excluded: {prefab} is excluded. Its shape cannot be mirrored safely.
Messages.Boat: Boat building pieces are not mirrored.
Messages.Grade: Only the default placement grade is mirrored.
Messages.Range: That piece is outside the symmetry range ({dist}m).
Messages.Rate: Symmetry is pausing briefly so placement stays within the rate limit.
Messages.NoSockets: This piece has no sockets symmetry can validate.
Messages.Revoked: Symmetry permission was removed. Mirroring stopped.
Messages.DenyPose: exact mirror position was not kept

Documentation: Permission: nightshadesymmetry.use. Nothing is granted automatically and admin status is not a bypass.
Example grant, documentation only: c.grant group <group> nightshadesymmetry.use

Center look: /symmetry center aims at a building block. The center is that block pivot, not the bounds center and not your feet. The two mirror planes are vertical and use the block yaw (forward flattened to the horizontal).
Center here: /symmetry center here uses your feet and your horizontal look direction. Add snap to round that yaw to the nearest 90 degrees.

Each placement can add at most three copies: left-right, front-back, and the opposite corner. Each copy pivot keeps the same distance from the center, the same height, and the mirrored horizontal offset. Pieces on an axis are not duplicated. This is reflection, not four 90-degree copies, and it does not use negative scale. A copy that cannot stay on that exact pose is skipped.

The original piece is placed and charged by vanilla. Each mirrored copy is charged the full default-grade construction cost only after it spawns and stays stable. Creative free-build and tutorial follow Planner.PayForPlacement and do not take items there either.
Eligible pieces are attempted only when their live sockets match a proper rotation of the reflected shape. Chiral stairs are excluded. Unknown prefabs are rejected.
Centers can persist across reload and are cleared when the wipe id, seed, or world size changes. Symmetry is always off after reload, reconnect, death, or permission loss.
There is no mirrored upgrade, rotate, or demolish in this version.
Hard caps: distance 80m, nearby search 6m, 20 placements per second.
